examples.label: Breadth vs depth
examples.command: # Vulnerability Assessment = find every issue (breadth); Penetration Test = exploit to prove impact (depth)

notes:
Vulnerability Assessment: breadth, automated scanning, list findings (no exploitation).
Penetration Test: exploit to prove impact. Black box (no info) / Grey box (some) / White box (full).
Types: Application, Network/Infra, Physical, Social Engineering.
Security Audit: compliance-focused. Bug Bounty: crowdsourced, scoped.
Red Team: goal-driven adversary simulation, stealth. Purple Team: red + blue collaborating.

recommended.note: The methodology for the chosen assessment.
